Summary.en: Rejects input values that are on a configurable blacklist.
Summary.de: Lehnt Eingabewerte ab, die auf einer konfigurierbaren Blacklist stehen.
Summary.it: Rifiuta i valori di input presenti in una blacklist configurabile.

Parameter.List: A string CSV of forbidden values.
Parameter.Prefix: The string to show before listing all the values in List when displaying an error message.
Parameter.Postfix: The string to show after List when displaying an error message.
Parameter.Separator: The string shown in between each element of the List when displaying an error message. Defaults to ', '.
Parameter.ShowBlacklist: Whether to show the List in the error message or not (true/false). Defaults to false.

List.default: A string CSV of forbidden values.

Prefix.default: The string to show before listing all the values in List when displaying an error message.

Postfix.default: The string to show after List when displaying an error message.
